src: non-background, non-teal colors with multiple 4-connected components
path: from each component to the next same-colored component in row-major order, take a shortest clear one-bend horizontal/vertical path through background or same color; teal wall segments and other colors block the path
dst: next same-colored component in the ordered chain
trajectory: paint every background pixel on each connector path with the source color
transform: keep teal wall segments, single-component colors, and all original foreground pixels unchanged
multi_step: process each color's components in row-major order; when both bends are clear, preserve the previous travel axis, otherwise use the longer-axis-first clear bend
